pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH repeat_donors AS (SELECT Donor FROM donations GROUP BY Donor HAVING COUNT("Receipt No") > 1), repeat_donations AS (SELECT SUM(Amount) AS repeat_total FROM donations WHERE Donor IN (SELECT Donor FROM repeat_donors)), total_donations AS (SELECT SUM(Amount) AS total FROM donations) SELECT (rd.repeat_total * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(td.total, 0), 0)) AS percentage, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Donor) FROM repeat_donors) AS donor_count FROM repeat_donations AS rd CROSS JOIN total_donations AS td

CURRENT QUESTION:
out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
attempts.response:
WITH repeat_donors AS (
    SELECT Donor
    FROM donations
    GROUP BY Donor
    HAVING COUNT("Receipt No") > 1
),
repeat_donations AS (
    SELECT SUM(Amount) AS repeat_total
    FROM donations
    WHERE Donor IN (SELECT Donor FROM repeat_donors)
),
total_donations AS (
    SELECT SUM(Amount) AS total
    FROM donations
)
SELECT 
    (rd.repeat_total * 100.0 / NULLIF(td.total, 0)) AS percentage,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Donor) FROM repeat_donors) AS donor_count
FROM repeat_donations rd, total_donations td;
